# Overview {#sec-overview}

These are the figures that made it into the final manuscript.

```{r setup}
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(conflicted)
library(units)
library(qs)
library(here)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(gt)

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter(),
  dplyr::select(),
  scales::rescale(),
  ggplot2::theme_void(),
  ggplot2::aes(),
  .quiet = T
)
```

```{r source-scripts}
#| cache: false

install_unit("t_fish", "1000 kg_fish")
```

# Get data {#sec-get-data}

```{r location-globals-farm}
#| code-summary: "Get locations of farms for mapping"

farm_locs <- file.path(input_farm_coords_path, "farm_static_data.qs") %>% 
  qread() %>% 
  rename(farm_ID = farm_id) %>%
  mutate(
    longitude = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    latitude = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    country = as.factor(country),
    region = case_when(
      country %in% c("Canada", "United States of America") & longitude < -100 ~ "North America (WC)", 
      country %in% c("Canada", "United States of America") & longitude < -50 ~ "North America (EC)", 
      country %in% c("Ireland", "United Kingdom") ~ "UK & Ireland",
      country %in% c("Iceland", "Faroe Islands") ~ "Iceland & FI",
      country %in% c("Norway", "Finland") ~ "Scandinavia",
      country == "Australia" ~ "Australia",
      country == "Chile" ~ "Chile", 
      country == "Russian Federation" ~ NA
    ) %>% as.factor()
  )

farm_temps <- file.path(input_farm_coords_path, ("farm_temporal_data.qs")) %>% 
  qread() %>% 
  rename(farm_ID = farm_id) %>% 
  group_by(farm_ID) %>% 
  reframe(mean_temp = mean(temp_c))

farm_locs <- farm_locs %>% 
  left_join(farm_temps, by = join_by(farm_ID))
```

```{r cleaning-helper-function}
clean_up <- function(df) {
  df %>% 
  convert_feeds_to_levels() %>% 
  mutate(
    feed = factor(
      feed, 
      levels = c("marine_dominant_biomar", "plant_dominant_biomar", "animal_dominant_biomar"),
      labels = c("MD", "PD", "AD")
    ),
    mean_value_perbiom = mean_value_perbiom %>% set_units("g g_fish-1") %>% set_units("kg t_fish-1"),
    sd_per_biom = sd_per_biom %>% set_units("g g_fish-1") %>% set_units("kg t_fish-1"),
    mean_value = mean_value %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("kg"),
    sd_value = sd_value %>% set_units("g") %>% set_units("kg")
  )
}
```

# Main text figures {#sec-main-text-figures}

## Figure 2: Global loading of C and N {#sec-global-loading}

This code generates all the parts that make up Figure 2. These parts were then put together manually and labels added with PowerPoint.

```{r get-global-loadings-data}
#| code-summary: "Prepare combined C and N data for plotting"

farm_ends_carbon <- file.path(output_path, "model_run_outputs", "farm_ends_total_carbon.qs") %>% 
  qread() %>% clean_up() %>% 
  mutate(nutrient = as.factor("C")) %>% 
  select(-mean_value, -sd_value)

farm_ends_nitrogen <- file.path(output_path, "model_run_outputs", "farm_ends_total_nitrogen.qs") %>% 
  qread() %>% clean_up() %>% 
  mutate(nutrient = as.factor("N")) %>% 
  select(-mean_value, -sd_value)

global_C_data <- farm_ends_carbon %>% 
  merge(farm_locs, by = "farm_ID") %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>% 
  st_transform(crs = crs_str_mercator) %>% 
  select(farm_ID, feed, measure, mean_value_perbiom, nutrient, feed_level, country) %>% 
  filter(feed_level == "mean") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = feed, values_from = mean_value_perbiom) %>% 
  mutate(
    diff_PD = PD - MD,
    diff_AD = AD - MD
  )

global_N_data <- farm_ends_nitrogen %>% 
  merge(farm_locs, by = "farm_ID") %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>% 
  st_transform(crs = "+proj=robin") %>% 
  select(farm_ID, feed, measure, mean_value_perbiom, nutrient, feed_level, country) %>% 
  filter(feed_level == "mean") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = feed, values_from = mean_value_perbiom) %>% 
  mutate(
    diff_PD = PD - MD,
    diff_AD = AD - MD
  )
```

```{r global-plot-formatting}

north_band_bbox <- band_bbox_mercator( 41,  75)
south_band_bbox <- band_bbox_mercator(-58, -24)

band_coords_north <- function() {
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(north_band_bbox["xmin"], north_band_bbox["xmax"]), 
    ylim = c(north_band_bbox["ymin"], north_band_bbox["ymax"]), expand = FALSE
  )
}

band_coords_south <- function() {
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(south_band_bbox["xmin"], south_band_bbox["xmax"]), 
    ylim = c(south_band_bbox["ymin"], south_band_bbox["ymax"]), expand = FALSE
  )
}

scale_C_vals <- function() {scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", breaks = seq(50, 80, 5), limits = c(50, 81))}
scale_C_diff <- function() {scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", breaks = seq(0, 12, 2), limits = c(1.5, 11.5))}
scale_N_vals <- function() {scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", breaks = seq(6, 10, 1), limits = c(6, 10.25))}
scale_N_diff <- function() {scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", breaks = seq(0, 4, 0.5), limits = c(0.5, 3.5))}

colourbar_C_values <- guides(
  color = guide_colourbar(
    title = expression(atop("C loading", paste("(kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")"))),
    direction = "vertical", 
    position = "right",
    label.position = "right", 
    title.position = "top",
    title.vjust = 1, 
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    frame.colour = "black", 
    ticks.colour = "black",
    ticks.linewidth = 1,
    barwidth = 1.25, 
    barheight = 8,
  ))

colourbar_C_diff <- guides(
  color = guide_colourbar(
    title = expression(atop("Difference, C", paste("(kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")"))),
    direction = "vertical", 
    position = "right",
    label.position = "right", 
    title.position = "top",
    title.vjust = 1, 
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    frame.colour = "black", 
    ticks.colour = "black",
    ticks.linewidth = 1,
    barwidth = 1.25, 
    barheight = 12,
  ))

colourbar_N_values <- guides(
  color = guide_colourbar(
    title = expression(atop("N loading", paste("(kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")"))),
    direction = "vertical", 
    position = "right",
    label.position = "right", 
    title.position = "top",
    title.vjust = 1, 
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    frame.colour = "black", 
    ticks.colour = "black",
    ticks.linewidth = 1,
    barwidth = 1.25, 
    barheight = 8,
  ))

colourbar_N_diff <- guides(
  color = guide_colourbar(
    title = expression(atop("Difference, N", paste("(kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")"))),
    direction = "vertical", 
    position = "right",
    label.position = "right", 
    title.position = "top",
    title.vjust = 1, 
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    frame.colour = "black", 
    ticks.colour = "black",
    ticks.linewidth = 1,
    barwidth = 1.25, 
    barheight = 12,
  ))
```

```{r create-nutrient-loading-maps}

  scale_C_vals() + colourbar_C_values + 
  prettyplot_600() + remove_map_axes()
```

```{r fig-2-left-global-carbon-loading}
#| code-summary: "Map global C loading"
#| fig-cap: "Map showing global distribution of total carbon loading for the MD feed at mean digestibility, and the difference between MD and PD/AD."
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 8

border <- element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)

plot_grid(
  p_MD_C_north + theme(panel.border = border), 
  p_MD_C_south + theme(panel.border = border), 
  p_PD_C_north + theme(panel.border = border), 
  p_PD_C_south + theme(panel.border = border), 
  p_AD_C_north + theme(panel.border = border), 
  p_AD_C_south + theme(panel.border = border), 
  nrow = 8, 
  rel_heights = c(1.75, 1, 1.75, 1, 1.75, 1, 1.75, 1)
)
```


```{r fig-2-colourbars}
#| code-summary: "Extract and display colour bar legends for global nutrient loading maps"
#| fig-cap: "Colour bar legends for global C and N loading maps (top: MD absolute loading; bottom: PD and AD difference from MD)."
#| fig-height: 4

plot_grid(
  ggpubr::get_legend(p_MD_C_north + theme(legend.position = "right")),
  ggpubr::get_legend(p_MD_N_north + theme(legend.position = "right")),
  ncol = 2

plot_grid(
```

## Figure 3: Carbon loading {#sec-figure-3}

```{r data-figure-3}

farm_ends_carbon_2 <- qread(file.path(data_analysis_path, "farm_ends_carbon.qs"))
coefs_carbon <- qread(file.path(data_analysis_path, "coefs_carbon.qs"))

combined_df_C <- farm_ends_carbon_2 %>%
  mutate(mean_value_perbiom = mean_value_perbiom %>% set_units("g g_fish-1") %>% set_units("kg t_fish-1") %>% drop_units()) %>% 
  left_join(coefs_carbon, by = c("feed", "feed_level" = "digest_level")) %>% 
  mutate(
    fitted = a * mean_temp^b + c,
    feed_level = factor(feed_level, levels = c("min", "mean", "max"), labels = c("Minimum", "Mean", "Maximum"))
  )
```

```{r fig-3-carbon-temperature}
#| code-summary: "Show change in total carbon loading with temperature"
#| fig-cap: "Total kg C t fish-1 with mean farm temperature."
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.5

combined_df_C %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_temp, colour = feed)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_value_perbiom), shape = 19, size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted), alpha = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 17, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 150, 20)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = feed_pal) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Mean farm temperature ("~degree*"C)"),
    y = expression("Carbon loading (kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")")
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(feed_level)) +
  prettyplot_600()
```

# Supplementary figures {#sec-supplementary-figures}

## Supplementary Figure 1: Harvest sizes {#sec-harvest-sizes}

```{r fig-supplementary-1-harvest-sizes}
#| code-summary: "Plot distribution of individual harvest weights across farms"
#| fig-cap: "Individual harvest weights (plant-dominant diet)."

file.path(gendata_path, "harvest_sizes", "farm_harvest_sizes.qs") %>% 
  qread() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = weight/1000)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, colour = "black", fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 350, 50), limits = c(0, 375)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6, 1), limits = c(1, 6)) + 
  prettyplot_600() +
  labs(x = "Mean individual harvest weight (kg)", y = "Farm count")
```

## Supplementary Figure 2: Daily values {#sec-daily-values}

```{r get-daily-values}
#| code-summary: "Load and summarise daily C and N loading by country"

farm_runs <- map2_dfr(
  c(file.path(output_path, "model_run_outputs", "farm_runs_total_carbon.qs"),
    file.path(output_path, "model_run_outputs", "farm_runs_total_nitrogen.qs")),
  c("C", "N"),
  function(fnm, nutr) {
    fnm %>% 
      qread() %>% 
      clean_up() %>% 
      filter(feed == "MD" & feed_level == "mean") %>% 
      mutate(nutrient = as.factor(nutr))
    }
  ) %>% 
  left_join(farm_locs, by = join_by(farm_ID))

# How many farms per country? 10 seems like enough
farm_runs <- farm_runs %>% 
  group_by(country, prod_t, nutrient) %>% 
  reframe(
    n = n(),
    mean_value_perbiom = mean(mean_value_perbiom),
    sd_per_biom = sqrt(mean(sd_per_biom^2))
  )
```

```{r fig-supplementary-2-daily-values}
#| code-summary: "Plot daily C loading over the production cycle by country"
#| fig-height: 7.5
#| fig-cap: "Daily carbon loading over the production cycle for the marine-dominant feed at mean digestibility, summarised by country."

farm_runs %>% 
  filter(nutrient == "C") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = prod_t, 
    y = mean_value_perbiom, 
    ymin = mean_value_perbiom - sd_per_biom, 
    ymax = mean_value_perbiom + sd_per_biom, 
    colour = country,
    fill = country
  )) +
  geom_line(linewdith = 0.75) +
  geom_ribbon(linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.25) +
  prettyplot_600() +
  labs(
    x = "Day of production",
    y = expression("Nutrient loading (kg"~t[fish]^{-1}*")")
)
```

## Supplementary Figure 3: Model sensitivity {#sec-model-sensitivity}

```{r sensitivity-data}
sens <- file.path(output_sens_data_path, "sens_all.qs") %>% 
  qread() %>% 
  filter(measure %in% c("weight_stat", "total_excr_stat") & adj_param != "nruns") %>% 
  mutate(
    measure = factor(measure, 
      levels = c("weight_stat", "total_excr_stat"), 
      labels = c("Individual weight", "Total excreted")
    ))

param_names <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,        ~lab,
  "alpha",      bquote(alpha),
  "epsprot",    bquote(epsilon["P"]),
  "epslip",     bquote(epsilon["L"]),
  "epscarb",    bquote(epsilon["C"]),
  "epsO2",      bquote(epsilon["O"[2]]),
  "pk",         bquote("pk"),
  "k0",         bquote("k"[0]),
  "m",          bquote("m"),
  "n",          bquote("n"),
  "betac",      bquote(beta*"C"),
  "Tma",        bquote("T"["max"]),
  "Toa",        bquote("T"["opt"]),
  "Taa",        bquote("T"["min"]),
  "omega",      bquote(omega),
  "a",          bquote("a"),
  "k",          bquote("k"),
  "eff",        bquote("eff"),
  "meanW",      bquote(bar("W")),
  "deltaW",     bquote(Delta*"W"), 
  "meanImax",   bquote(bar("I"["max"])),
  "deltaImax",  bquote(Delta*"I"["max"]),
  "overFmean",  bquote(bar("F")),
  "overFdelta", bquote(Delta*"F"),
  "mortmyt",    bquote("mort")
)

sens_x_labels <- c(paste0('\u2212', '10'), '0', '10', '20', '30', '40')
```

```{r fig-sensitivity}
#| code-summary: "Plot parameter sensitivity for individual weight and total excreted nutrients"
#| fig-cap: "Parameter sensitivity for individual weight and total excreted nutrient outputs."
#| fig-height: 6

sens %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = adj_param, y = mean_sens, ymin = mean_sens-sd_sens, ymax = mean_sens+sd_sens)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(param_names$name), labels = rev(param_names$lab)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 40, 10), labels = sens_x_labels, limits = c(-11, 41)) +
  facet_wrap(~measure) +
  prettyplot_600() +
  labs(x = "Adjusted parameter", y = "Sensitivity")
```
